rulesets.ng_plus: New Game Plus (the *_plus folders); 'NGP X' items are the carry-over copies of X

bonuses.text: Strong Attacks increase Fast Attack damage for 5 seconds by 10% for each piece of the set. Current bonus: {current}%.
Rear attacks deal 50% more damage, and also stun opponents at the cost of 1 Adrenaline Point(s).
After using Stamina to cast a Sign in its standard mode, the next Sign cast within 3 seconds will be cast in standard mode without using Stamina.
The size of Yrden traps is increased by 40%. While you are within an Yrden trap, Stamina regeneration is increased by 5/s and Sign Intensity by 100%, and damage is reduced by 20%.
When a Quen shield shatters, there is a chance a new one will be cast at no Stamina cost. The bonus increases by 5% for each piece of the set. Current chance is: {current}%.
Damage dealt by Abilities involving the Quen Sign is increased by 200%.
Each instance of Bleeding applied to enemies increases sword damage by 1% for each piece of the set. Current bonus: {current}%.
Each Adrenaline Point increases the possible number of Bleeding effects that can be applied to a single enemy.

bonuses.text: Increases the duration of potions. The bonus increases by 7% for each piece of the set.

Killing opponents restores Vitality. The amount of Vitality restored equals 1% of maximum Vitality for each element of the set worn. Currently, that amount is: {current}%.

set_bonus.text: A piece counts only if it has the SetBonusPiece tag and its set tag; at 3 pieces the first bonus is active, at 6 the second (Vampire has one bonus at 3). See sets[*].bonuses.

required_level.where: inventoryComponent.GetItemLevel, shown as 'Requires level N' (red when above the player's level)
required_level.armor: floor(1 + (armor - 25) / 5); boots and trousers: floor(1 + (armor - 5) / 2); gloves: floor(1 + (armor - 1) / 2)
required_level.steel sword: ceil(1 + (1 + sum(damage_i - 1) - 25) / 8) over slashing, bludgeoning, rending, elemental, fire, silver, piercing
required_level.silver sword: ceil(1 + (1 + sum(damage_i - 1) - 90) / 10) over silver, bludgeoning, rending, elemental, fire, piercing
required_level.bolts: a fixed level per bolt name, minus 14/10/6/4 for quality 5/4/3/2
required_level.then: minus 1; at least 1; set gear (quality 5) minus 2, relic (4) minus 1; at least 1; EP1-tagged relic or set gear minus 1; 'OlgierdSabre' minus 3 (capped at the player's maximum level)
required_level.assumption: an attribute the item does not define counts as 0 (the engine default is not in the scripts); not computed for Autogen items

primary_stat.crossbow: 'Damage' = the equipped bolt's primary stat (Bodkin Bolt PiercingDamage if none) x the crossbow's attack_power multiplier
primary_stat.shown: rounded to a whole number; steel swords never list SilverDamage and silver swords never list SlashingDamage in the stat list

stat_list.value: a multiplicative value is a percentage (value x 100, rounded, 'NN %'); focus_gain is shown as is; other values are rounded to a whole number
stat_list.order_color_percent: the order, colour and percentage flag of each line come from gameplay/globals/tooltip_settings.csv, which is NOT in the files we have

ng_plus.text: Two rulesets. ng = first playthrough (gameplay/items): the witcher gear tiers Basic to Grandmaster, levels 17 to 40; only the top tier carries SetBonusPiece. ng_plus = New Game Plus (the *_plus folders): the same ids are redefined as 'legendary' gear (levels 47 to 70, every tier counts for set bonuses) and 'NGP X' are carry-over copies of the first-playthrough items (same stats as X in ng); NewGamePlusReplaceItem swaps X for 'NGP X' when a New Game Plus starts. The tooltip also adds (NG+ level - minimum NG+ level) x the autogen_fixed damage/armour step to the primary stat. Both rulesets also have a few items named 'Legendary ...' (e.g. Manticore, level 70).

autogen.text: Autogen item: the XML holds only the formula ranges (autogen.abilities); the game scales damage or armour with the item level, so the base numbers are not in the files and required_level is null
